purpose: VS-00 source inventory of the Courtwork app navigation, distinct surfaces, and observable states. This records implementation seams and gaps; it is not a product specification or visual acceptance.

baseline.source_scope: app/web, app/server, app/core, app/docs, and baseline app/tests
baseline.evidence_mode: Static source inspection at the pinned main SHA; no browser capture or product acceptance was performed.
baseline.path_policy: All source and test references are repository-relative and use path:line where a line range is material.

entries.behavior: Clears the active Session and renders cross-session Home data.
Creates a Session, optionally under a Project, then selects it.
Loads GET /sessions/:id and resets per-session surface/read generations.

entries.entry_path: #attention-button; Home Attention heading; assistant Attention items
entries.behavior: The nav entry opens the global assistant; the assistant can open the queue.
Opens the read-only derivation dialog for a preferred Project.
Replaces the main content with a page, hides the global sidebar, and restores the prior focus/path on exit.
Usage is an on-demand dialog rather than a primary nav item.

responsive_states.behavior: Work surface can use a real third pane.
Work surface uses a view switch.
Navigation and Work surface use overlays/modal presentation.

nearest_implemented_precedent.reason: Read-only stat strip uses the existing presentation adapter and filters its own set.
Activity module is the local precedent for a bounded read, range selector, heatmap, loading, and last-confirmed error.
Attention module keeps registry rows and selected detail separate.

capabilities: Shows Today values for pendingItems, sessionCandidates, and inspectionCandidates when work-summary supplies them.
Reads retained activity for 28 or 84 days from work-activity and exposes day labels/keyboard navigation.
Reads Attention registry data per Project, opens read-only item detail, and pages server results.
Offers Home chat start, Project choice, file-access choice, and Manage connections through existing controls.
gaps: The Models module is installed in the module list but has no source (`home-view.mjs:166-171`); it is not evidence of model data.
Home has no independent user research or visual acceptance evidence in this inventory.
The Home layer reads existing backend projections; it does not create a new queue, metric, or authority.
Run/recorded-runs wording and any semantic registry migration remain separate VS-01 decisions.

test_methods.dynamic_check: Not run in this inventory; browser states, focus, and responsive layout require a later fixed fixture.

nearest_implemented_precedent.reason: Pure projection groups recorded events into User, Assistant, tool, Question, Permission, Artifact, Notice, Error, and Run status rows.
Shared authored-message anatomy provides immutable Edit-as-new, Copy, long-message disclosure, and source reading.
Pending Question/Permission rows use a separate list from the conversation stream.

capabilities: Loads a Session by id and restores draft/surface boundaries across session changes.
Renders authored messages, assistant responses, grouped tool activity, questions, permission requests, artifacts, notices, errors, and run status.
Provides Send, Cancel run, file-access context, model/effort picker entry, message Copy, and Edit as new draft.
Preserves run status and decision receipts in the stream; cancel-requested remains distinct from stopped.
gaps: Chat does not provide a session rename/delete/pin/archive control in the baseline navigation.
The stream renders only facts supplied by Session/Run/event projections; it does not create a generic retry, Queue, Steer, or new workflow object.
No browser interaction or user research evidence is part of this source inventory.

test_methods.synthetic_fixture: Feed deterministic Session events and Run records covering each row kind, active/cancel-requested/failed/unknown status, invalid or resolved receipts, and a long authored message.
test_methods.dynamic_check: Use the existing fake/local adapter and assert DOM labels plus request payloads; do not call a paid provider or a personal Session.

nearest_implemented_precedent.reason: Workspace module owns the current file tree, loading/error states, extension slot fallback, and open-file handoff.
Tree/session overview and run history are the existing read-only workspace panel pattern.
Host owns responsive surface expansion, view switch, modal, and focus behavior.

capabilities: Shows Workspace, Run, and File tab roles with at most one closeable recorded-document tab.
Reads GET /sessions/:id/workspace into a current file tree and opens current files.
Shows extension owner/status/state-version facts and keeps absent renderers read-only.
Supports responsive third-pane, view-switch, and narrow modal paths.
gaps: An extension renderer is a contingent slot; the host fallback cannot execute declared actions when that renderer is absent.
The runtime module has no own pane; it opens Settings › Developer so the catalog has one source.
Current workspace files and recorded run versions remain separate readings; the UI does not make them one mutable file object.

test_methods.synthetic_fixture: Stub workspace responses as loading, empty, error, current files, and bound extension with renderer-absent/unsupported projection; vary viewport thresholds independently.
test_methods.dynamic_check: Check tab selection, modal/expanded transitions, Escape, focus return, and current-file open against the same Session id.

nearest_implemented_precedent.reason: Run rail card and pane share the Session/Run identity and recorded artifacts.
Run summary card is the bounded inline disclosure and stale-identity guard.
Inspector is the existing detail reader for run status, usage, telemetry, and activity.

capabilities: Opens a selected Run only when it belongs to the current Session.

Refreshes the Run and exposes content-version files through the File reader.
Keeps loading, empty, unknown, error, unavailable, and incompatible reader phases distinct in the summary projection.
gaps: No true parent/child span or timeline hierarchy is available; host timing rows remain linear facts.
Provider TTFT, decode TPS, and token-delta measurements are not present; host first output must not be relabeled as provider timing.
Null or incomplete telemetry fields remain explicit rather than becoming invented measurements.

test_methods.dynamic_check: Exercise Run tab, summary disclosure, refresh, stale Session/Run generation, and open-file callbacks with a fixed local adapter.

entry_paths: Work surface Workspace tab → review-bearing Work projection

nearest_implemented_precedent.reason: WorkPacket decodes Matter/candidate/decision/source facts and only treats schemaVersion 1 findings as a domain Review.
Rule disclosure shows status, reason, source anchors, frozen quote, and recorded-source read.
Decision words identify the version being decided and preserve rejection/evidence-request distinctions.

capabilities: Reads Matter version/source/candidate lineage, per-rule findings, reasons, evidence anchors, decisions, sources, and accepted version when the WorkPacket supplies them.
Reads historical source bytes from the candidate's frozen revision through bounded GET queries.
Recognizes advertised decide/revise_candidate action descriptors; the host fallback displays declared actions as text when no producer renderer is mounted.
Keeps a candidate without a compatible domain review as candidate text rather than guessing acceptance from field names.
gaps: Review is a Work projection, not a separate top-level route or new object in this baseline.
Fallback rendering is read-only; execution controls belong to the producer renderer and advertised action contract.
A recorded artifact or permission receipt does not itself establish Review acceptance; the UI says when acceptance is not recorded.

test_methods.synthetic_fixture: Use WorkPacket variants with no candidates, plain candidate, schemaVersion 1 findings, unresolved rules, frozen source anchors, declared decide/revise actions, unsupported schema, and accepted artifact.
test_methods.dynamic_check: Verify rule/source disclosures and action visibility against packet descriptors; do not infer action capability from a visible candidate alone.

nearest_implemented_precedent.reason: File reader validates current/content-version/core-file identity and hashes before reading.
Markdown reader, preview fallback, truncation, provenance, recorded/current comparison, and hash copy are existing detail behavior.
File rail separates Current, Recorded, Candidate, and Artifact readings.

capabilities: Opens current workspace bytes, run-saved content versions, and core candidate/artifact files through distinct locators.
Shows path, bytes/hash, Markdown structured preview where supported, raw fallback, truncation note, provenance, and recorded/current comparison.
Provides retry after a read failure and keeps invalid identity/hash/path responses out of the reader.
gaps: The reader does not provide a write or acceptance action; file content and Review acceptance remain separate owners.
Large/complex Markdown falls back to preview or preformatted text; source positions are unavailable in that fallback.
A missing/forbidden response is an unavailable reading, not evidence that the file does not exist.

test_methods.synthetic_fixture: Serve current, content-version, candidate, and artifact manifests with valid SHA-256, mismatched hash, traversal path, 403, truncation, malformed Markdown, and retry responses.
test_methods.dynamic_check: Select each locator kind from Workspace/Run/Review and assert the displayed provenance and Session/Run guard.

nearest_implemented_precedent.reason: The existing inspector owns run detail sections and explicit unknown/unavailable values.
Details and file disclosures are guarded by current identity and generation on every action.
Request telemetry is a small pure renderer consumed by both Inspector and Attention.

capabilities: Makes exact Session/Run/provider/model/API/adapter/timing/native-session/credential-generation identifiers inspectable when supplied.
Supports bounded disclosures for Usage, recorded context, run notes, files, and latest 100 events.
Displays request host timing measurements and explicit null/incomplete telemetry fields.
gaps: There is no provider token timeline, provider TTFT, decode TPS, or span-parent hierarchy in the baseline data.
Telemetry presentation is a renderer over existing request facts; it cannot supply absent measurements.
Identity and generation guards protect stale reads but do not create a new history/Trace domain object.

test_methods.synthetic_fixture: Use one run with complete host timings and one with null timing fields, missing usage, malformed artifacts, and 100+ events; test stale generation responses.
test_methods.dynamic_check: Open each disclosure and confirm identity, focus return, and no fabricated measurement appears in unknown/incomplete states.

nearest_implemented_precedent.reason: Six query views are All plus the five contract statuses; a view is a filter, not a new status.
Registry rows and selected detail keep list facts separate from inspect facts.
Advertised typed actions use revision/idempotency and distinguish refusal from an unknown receipt.

states: each of five contract status views
capabilities: Queries Project-scoped Attention registry data in server order with paging and selected detail.
Shows source refs, policy/basis/relations, recorded next action and due time without creating a scheduler.
Renders only schema-advertised actions and posts revision/idempotency-bound requests; conflict/not-found paths re-inspect where required.
Returns focus to the selected or nearest surviving row after detail/action changes.
gaps: There is no guaranteed batch operation, priority ranking, snooze scheduler, or separate Inbox authority in the baseline.
Action availability is descriptor-driven; an unadvertised action has no button, even if a similar word would be convenient.
The queue is not the global assistant conversation and does not itself start a Run.

test_methods.synthetic_fixture: Use app/tests/fixtures/attention-actions.json plus registry/detail fixtures for all five statuses, paging, revision conflict, idempotency conflict, not-found, refusal, and unknown receipt recovery.
test_methods.dynamic_check: Run the local HTTP fixture; assert only advertised actions render and that retries reuse the same request identity.

Settings hash/group navigation is a page route, not a Session, Run, or backend authority.

limitations: The inventory is source evidence at main@590739fa3d1bc401905261172260143e36e82c5e, not a claim about later worktree edits or product acceptance.
No browser screenshots, keyboard/Touch/VoiceOver run, user study, external provider, personal data, or paid provider was used.
Test files and fixture methods are recorded as reproducible follow-up paths; this inventory did not run the product suite.
Gaps describe absent or bounded baseline capability where source inspection supports it; they do not propose architecture, schema, or release decisions.
Some extension, provider, telemetry, and Attention states depend on host/API payloads and require fixed synthetic fixtures for dynamic verification.
